selection.method: outcome-blind SHA-256 rank over all 100 integer block IDs
selection.registration_caveat: The selection was frozen after the original REBOUND execution but before any DOP853 final run. It is retained unchanged for v2.

classification.injection_rule: minimum annually sampled osculating perihelion is strictly below 29.999999 AU

statistics.effect_definition: source minus control annually sampled-injection fraction
statistics.effect_classification_rule: positive or negative only if the paired-block bootstrap interval excludes zero; equivalent only if the full interval is inside the locked margin

corrective_change.trigger: v1 exceeded only the active-only endpoint position gate: 1.2753222959586786e-6 AU observed versus 1e-6 AU locked.
corrective_change.diagnosis: The v1 tracer-loaded active endpoints agreed pairwise within 5.574007764044481e-9 AU, while a half-step active-only reference improved energy conservation to 7.078989912787948e-13. The failed comparison was therefore attributed to adaptive-resolution dependence.
corrective_change.change_from_v1: Tighten rtol from 1e-12 to 1e-13, atol from 1e-14 to 1e-15, and maximum step from 0.25 to 0.125 years.
corrective_change.unchanged: Selection, physical model, duration, cadence, statistics, all numerical gates, all cross-software gates, and fail-closed verdict logic remain unchanged.
corrective_change.provenance_warning: This repair was designed after v1 outcomes were available. It is a transparent corrective replication, not the original preregistered attempt.

scientific_scope: Correctively repeat the independent 10000-tracer-per-arm, 10000-year DOP853 replication at higher temporal resolution while retaining every v1 acceptance threshold.
limitations: The immutable v1 verdict remains INVALID; v2 is a separately registered corrective run.
The v2 solver settings were selected after observing the v1 numerical failure and population comparisons.
This is a 10000-year dynamical screen, not a Solar-System-age integration.
The independent run reuses the locked physical assumptions and initial states intentionally; it tests software and numerical-method dependence, not model dependence.
SciPy DOP853 is independent of REBOUND MERCURIUS, but both use binary64 arithmetic on the same machine class.
Only 10000 of the original 100000 tracers per arm are independently replicated.
The block selection was registered after the original REBOUND execution.
Candidate 9118 is a declared model assumption, not an observational fit, and only this candidate is tested.
The proposal is not an observed TNO population model or survey selection function.
Perihelion minima are sampled annually rather than continuously event-located.
The test particles are massless and do not interact with one another.
nonclaim: Passing can show robustness to this corrective independent-software test on the selected population. It cannot detect or exclude Planet X, validate candidate 9118, or convert a simulated effect into observational evidence.

allowed_verdicts.PASSED: All unchanged numerical-validity and cross-software gates pass; claim remains SCREENING_ONLY.
allowed_verdicts.CONFLICT: Numerical validity passes but one or more unchanged cross-software population gates fail.
allowed_verdicts.INVALID: One or more unchanged numerical-validity gates fail.
